tei:div.tei:p: (181)dpal chen bka' 'dus rgya mtsha las/ phur pa bdud dpung zil gnon bzhugs so/ (182)

phrin las phur pa'i l+laha la 'dud: yid dang chos kyi rtog tshogs kun: bya ba nan tan ye shes dbyings: sbyor byed badz+ra ku mā ra: rdo rje khros pa'i dgos sgrub bstan: sa ma ya: dkyil 'khor yongs rjogs bdag nyid can: bsnyen phur dam tshig chen po'i rten: sgrub dus dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin la: lha grangs mnyam pa'i phur pa'i rgyan: rgyan bkod mchod pa bzung du bshams: sngon 'gro dpal chen gzhung ltar la: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs yongs rjogs dkon mchog gsum gyi ngang : dpal chen 'dus pa'i ngo bor yongs shar ba: spro bsdu'i byed po byang chub sems kyi lhar: rang ngo shes pa'i ngang nas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings la phyogs ris mnyam brdal yang : ma rtog 'khrul bar 'khyams pa'i bdag 'jin bdud: 'od gsal chos sku'i dbyings su bsgral ba'i phyir: dpal chen lha tshogs bsgrub par sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ gsum pa tshogs gsogs ni: ho: rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo: (183)mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la: gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsaul: dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i gegs: nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi: phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos: ma chags spyod la rjais yi rang : dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med: rjogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do: bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la: dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo: tshe rabs bgrangs ba'i las rnams kun: bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo: bzhi pa bgegs la gtor gtong ba ni: hūm̐: nga ni spyi dpal chen po ste: byang chub sgrub la bar gcod pa'i: gnod byed log 'drena'abyung po rnams: gtor ma longs la phyir dengs shig: ga te bka' las 'da' byed rnams:

mgo bo tshal ba brgyar bkas shing : lus ni rdul phran bzhin du bshigs: drags sngags me dpung thun bcas brdeg: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhi shwa ri badz+ra (184)kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+ṣa ka la ru pa karma ram̐ ram̐ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: lnga pa mtshams gcod srung 'khor ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje yi: spyan mig nyi zla 'bar zhing bsregs: thugs las khro bo'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: sto gsum sprul pa'i me yis 'geng : phyogs mtshams mtshon cha 'chol bas gtams: bdag med stong par mtshams bcad doḥ oṃ sur+ya tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la raṃ raṃ tsakra warti ma hā kro dha sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ e hūm̐ phaṭa: drug pa brda sgo dbye phyag 'tshal: nongs bshags dam bca' bzung ba ni: hūm̐: ma rig ling thog ye shes thur mas dbye: sems nyid lha skur rtogs pa'i brda phyag 'tshal: 'gal 'khrul nongs pa chos sku'i klong du bshags: dpal chen srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo : a la la ho: bdun pa snod bcud byin 'beb ni: hūm̐: dpal chen 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ chos sku'i klong nas thugs rje bskyed: longs sku'i rnam rol cir yang bsgyur: sprul sku'i dkyil 'khor brten par bcas: dbang bskur byin phebs rtags mtshan ston: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ (185)bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba sa ma ya a be sha ya pheṃ pheṃ: brgyad pa mchod pa byin rlabs ni: hūm̐: dbyings nas yi ge 'bru gsum char du babs: mchod rdzas nyes skyon ma dag bsregs gtor bkrus: bh+rūm̐ las rin chen a las bhadha'i nang : phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin rgya mtshor gyur: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ: pad+yaṃ: puṣ+pe: dhup+pe: dī paṃ: gan+dhe: rū pa: shab+da: gan+dhe: ra pa: par+ṣe sarba pū tsa āḥhūm̐: sman gtor rak+ta'i sngags kyis brlabs: oṃ a hūm̐: sarba pañca amṛ ta hūm̐ hri ṭha: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling ta bha la bha ti gu h+ya sa ma yo swā hā: oṃ āḥhūm̐:

ma hā rak+ta sa man+ta man+ta la hūm̐ phaṭa: ting 'jin gsum la khyad chos ldan: rdo rje de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings: snying rje'i 'gal zla la khros pa: kun snang byang chub sems su shar: mtshon chen thugs kyi rdo rje ni: yig 'bru'i mtshon pa rgyu yin no: hūm̐: rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcod: thugs ni yang dag rdo rje nyid: stong pa nyid kyi ye shes te: rnam par mi rtog rtog las 'das: snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni: bsad (186)cing man pa ma yin te: phung po rdo rjes gtams byas nas: rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom: mtshon chen sngon po 'bar ba ni: nam mkha'i dkyil nas thig par shar: srog gi ge ru shar ba dang : snying gi ge ru bsgom par bya: rgyu las 'byung ba'i sa bon chad: e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ raṃ bh+rūm̐: e las nam mkha' yaṃ las g.yo byed rlung : ra las rak+ta sum las zhing chen gzhi: keṃ las rus pa'i ri rab bang rim can: raṃ las bskal me rab 'bar rngam brjid klong : hūm̐ las gnam lcags rdo rje'i brag chen steng : nam mkha'i dbyings nas bh+rūm̐ yig lnga ldan babs: bh+rūm̐ḥrat+na bhan+dza dz+nyā na tsakra maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐: bh+rūm̐ yig gnas 'gyur sprul ba'i gzhal med khang : phyi ni rin chen nang ni thod pa'i mkhar: gru bzhi sgo bzhi tshad dang mtshan nyid ldan: gu ṇa twa ra rta babs nang rim brgyad: chos 'khor ri dwags gdugs dang nor bu'i tog: phyi rol rin chen rtsigs pa'i rming gi gzhir: 'dod rnam dmar po lha mo bcu drug 'khad: pha gu ser po drwa ba drwa phyed mjes: (187)shar bu mda' yab khang brtsegs rdo rje'i tog: nang ni dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal med khang : phyi 'khor ro gling brgyad dang rdo rje'i gur: bskal me 'ur 'ur chem chem 'bar ba'i klong : 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i pho brang che: rab 'jigs gnam lcags tsakra rtsibs bcu'i dbus: bde chen kun tu bzang mo'i e klong dbyings:

rnam thar gsum ldan rdo rje'i btsun mo'i mkhar: ma chags pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla'i steng : ru tra pho mo bdud bzhi byi chings bsnol: saṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal: ma pūr+ya maṇ+ḍal: a tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍal: ja hūm̐ baṃ hoḥti ra bam̐: oṃ badz+ra a twa hūm̐: rdo rje hūm̐ yig yongs gyur las: rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum ni: mtshan dang dpe byad yang dag rjogs: kun+da lta bur dkar ba'i mdog: rig lnga khrag 'thung yab yum bcu: 'dus pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dīb+ta tsakra ha na ha na ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: zhe sdang khrag 'thung rgyal po dang*/ bde bar sbyor dang sgrol ba'i yum: (188)khro zhing rngam pa'i tshul bskyed pa: gdug pa ma lus sgrol bar byed: a dang hūm̐ gi rang bzhin sbyar: yum gyis yab kyi lce gzhibs nas: yum kyis thugs kar ut+pal gtad: zhu ba glus bskul gdung ba'i smras: hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'jin rnams: srid pa rdo rje bsgrub mjod cig: srid pa rdo rje phur ba'i lha: ye shes khro bo 'grub par mjod: s+pha ra ṇa phaṭaḥbarjod pas: rgyal ba mchod cing gzhan don byas: sam̐ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ brjod pas: phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams: yab yum sbyor ba'i mkha' ru zhugs: dgyes chags ngang la 'od du zhu: gong bu'i bdag nyid hūm̐ du gyur: yongs gyur 'bras bu'i he ru ka: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu ni: snying rje rngam zhi'i ngang nyid las: sgegs dpa' 'jigs su rung ba'i sku: rdzu 'phrul zhabs bzhi dor stabs bsgrad: rnam par thar ba'i dbu gsum gyis: skrag mjad bzhad gshed khro bo'i zhal: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing nag: spyan dmar smin ma sma ra ser: khro gnyer chu yi rlabs bzhin 'khrugs: (189)phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po yi: gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu dang : bar pa rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams: g.yon gyi dang po me dpung dang : bar pa kha ṭaṃ rtse gsum 'jin:

mtha' gnyis ri rab phur ba 'dril: mthing nag sku la dur khrod chas: rigs lnga thod pa lnga yis brgyan: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs bde ba'i yum: zhal gcig phyag gnyis thong sbrul brgyan: dril bu thod khrag 'jin pas 'gyud: e ka tsa ti sgrol ba'i yum: gri gug thod khrag khams gsum sgrol: re 'ga' kha ṭaṃ rtse gsum bsnams: g.yer kha dril bu nyid las kyang : rtog med chos kyi sgra 'byin cing : ma mo drug cu pho nyar 'gyed: hūm̐ las rdo rjair zla dkyil oṃ: sam̐ las pad 'dab nyi zlar mūṃ: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya staṃ: rā ga yā ho: rā g.ya me: brda dang brda len gyis bskul nas: ja ham̐ bam̐ hā+oḥphyag brgya bzhis: stong pa shin tu yod med las: chags pa lcags kyu rol pa zhags: tsum+pa sgrogs la sgra sgrags (190)dril: gnyis med byang chub sems kyi sprin: dang por babs pa yum gyi mkha': gzhal med khang byung gnyis pa gdan: gsum pa sa bon nyid du rdzogs: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku: ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa'i: sku yi dbyig tu bdag bskyed cig: oṃ bud+dha badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma kī li kī la ya sarba big+nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: sras mchog kī la rigs lnga ni: stong nyid dbyings las longs skur shar: sprul pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du: yum gyi bha gar lhun gyis grub: badz+ra sa ma jaḥs drangs nas: rigs lnga stongs dpyal bcu'i rang bzhin: thabs kyi thal mo'i bar du byon: bde ba'i rlabs kyis dbang rnams rjogs: dbang rtags rigs lngas dbu la brgyan: stod ni gtso bo yab 'dra la: smad ni chu srin phur bu'i dbal: lcags bsregs 'bar ba me stag 'phro: rgya mdud nad nas sngags sgra sgrogs: chu srin kha nas me lce dang : sdig sbrul sbal (191)lcong cho 'phrul 'gyed: stong gsum gdug pa'i klu rnams 'dul: thugs kar dkyil 'khor yongs rjogs dang*/ dbu la rigs lnga'i khrag 'thung rdzogs:

dgra s+t+wa g.yas la rang rtags g.yon: bar pa kha ṭ+waṃ gtun shing dang : tha ma ri rab phur pa 'dril: rgyud lnga ye shes lnga ru sgrol: dug lnga rtsad nas gcod par byed: sangs rgyas 'dus pa thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs su byin gyis rlobs: oṃ bhudha kī li kī la ya kā ya badz+ra nan: dz+wa la dz+wa la pra dz+wa la: s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa sarba na sa pa na ye hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ pad+ma kī li kī la ya wāk+ka badz+ra nan: sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ hri shwa dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya tsirta badz+ra nan: tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa: ces byin gyis brlabs nas byug bdug brag gsum gyis gzi byin bskyed pa ni: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā rak+ta dz+wa li ni hūm̐ phaṭa: lus kyi bkrag dang ldan pa dang : ba spu'i bu ga rdo rjes gtams: ma gu ta la pra ta la hūm̐ phaṭa: bhud+dha thams cad 'dus pa'i skur: khro bo du mas byin gyis (192)rlobs: be ta lī man+t+ra la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga kun: khro chung nyid kyis rab du gtams:ཿ khams gsum gdug pa bsgral ba'i phyir: gdul bya'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhi: zhes phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor dang dbyer med du bsam mo: de nas phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor du bskyed pa ni: gtso bo yab yum thugs ka nas: lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer gyis: phyogs skyong bkug nas gdan du bting : sbyor ba'i lam nas sgong nga bcu: phyung te sngags kyi sgra gdangs las: khro bcu khra thabs so sor gyur: oṃ badz+ra kro ta hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐: garja hūm̐ phaṭaḥgarja hūm̐ phaṭa: steng phyogs nyi ma'i gdan steng du: khro bo rado rje hūm̐ mjad ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs: yum chen rdo rje sgra 'byin ma: sprul pa phag dang smig bu'i mgo: oṃ badz+ra kro ta bī dza ya hūm̐: ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: shar phyogs dri za'i gdan steng du: khro bo rdo rje rnam par rgyal:

phyag na rtse gsum (193)'khor lo bsnams: yum chen rdo rje snyems ma dang : sprul pa stag dang bya rgod mgo: oṃ badz+ra kro ta nī la daṇ+ṭa hūm̐: da ha hūm̐ phaṭa: da ha hūm̐ phaṭa: shar lho me lha'i gdan steng du: nī la daṇ+ṭa dbyug pa me: yum chen rdo rje sder mo dang : sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog mgo: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ya man+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa: pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: lho phyogs gshin rje gdan steng du: khro bo rdo rje gshin rje gshed: phyag na thod dbyug dgra s+t+wa bsnams: yum chen dur khrod bdag mo dang : sprul pa sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ār+ya tsa la hūm̐: bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa: bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa: lho nub srin po'i gdan steng du: khro bo mi g.yo mgon po ni: phyag na ral gri zhags pa bsnams: yum chen rdo rje gtun khung ma: sprul pa gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo: oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa hrī: hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: nub phyogs klu dbang gdan steng du: khro bo chen po rta mgrin rgyal: (194)phyag na zhags pa spu gri bsnams: yum chen rdo rje gtum mo dang : sprul pa byi la su shud mgo: oṃ badz+ra kro ta a pa ra tsirta hūm̐: tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa: tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa: nub byang rlung lha'i gnad steng du: khro bo chen po gzhan las rgyal: phyag na mda' dang rnga yab bsnams: yum chen rdo rje mda' snyems ma: sprul pa spyang ki khra yi mgo: oṃ badz+ra kro ta amṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐: tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa: tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa: byang phyogs gnod sbyin gdan steng du: khro bo rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyil: phyag na dbyug to rgya gram bsnams: yum chen rdo rje rlung 'byin ma: sprul pa seng ge pha waṃ mgo: oṃ badz+ra kro ta traṃ lo kya bi ja ya hūm̐: bhi n+dha hūm̐ phaṭa: bhin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa: byang shar 'byung po'i gdan steng du: khro bo rdo rje khams gsum rgyal: phyag na lcags kyu rin chen bsnams:

yum chen rdo rje gsod ma dang : sprul pa dom dang sre mong mgo: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā ba la hūm̐: s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa: s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa: 'og phyogs sa bdag gdan steng (195)du: khro bo cheno pa stobs po che: phyag na rdo rje thong gzhol bsnams: yum chen rdo rje bskyod ma dang : sprul pa dred dang byi ba'i mgo: yum rnams g.yas pa dril bu dang : g.yon pa dung chen stobs cing 'khyud: kun kyang rdo rje'i gshogs pa gdengs: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brjid: mche ba can dang gshogs pa can: phra men mgo brnyan nyi shu ni: rtsibs mchan rnams la gnyis gnyis gnas: sbrul dang thod pas rab tu brgyan: phur pa lcags kyu phyag na bsnams: skra brdzes spyan dmar mche ba gcigs: lha tshogs kun kyang sku mdog nag: dus mtha'i 'od zer 'bar ba 'khrugs: de nas sgo ma bzhi bskyed pa ni: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya bing bing hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya nā maḥs man+ta hṛṃ hṛṃ hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya pra su ru pra su ru hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya mā ra ya mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: nyi zla yi ge bzhi nyid lasaḥ drod gsher las skyes sgo ma bzhi: shar phyogs (196)dri za'i gdan steng du: skya ga'i mgo can lcags kyu ma: lho phyogs grul bum gdan steng du: su shud mgo can zhags pa ma: nub phyogs chu bdag gdan steng du: srin bya'i mgo can lcags sgrogs ma: byang phyogs gnod sbyin gdan steng du: khra yi mgo can dril bu la: dkar ser dmar ljang thod sbrul brgyan: phyag g.yon pur pa bgegs la gzir: me dpung dbus na kun kyang rngams: drag po'i tshul gyis zhe sdang 'joms: mu ran la ni phur srung ste: e yaṃ ma ya bzhi po las: shwa na mu kha bzhi po gsal: jaḥyig bzhi las sa bdag bzhi: bh+yo yig bzhi las bdag nyid bzhi: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul glog las myur: bstan pa bsrung zhing nyams pa bdun:
zhe la brnag pa'i stobs kyis sgrol:

gnas gsum byin rlabs ni: snying ga mgrin pa spyi bo ru: zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam nas ni: rdo rje pad+ma 'khor lo dag: hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ gyis mtshan pa las: thugs gsung sku yi (197)rdo rjer bsgom: rdo rje'i phyag rgya gnas gsum du bzhag la: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā tsirta badz+ra swā bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ: de bzhin du wāk+ka dang : kā ya sbyar: dbang bskur ba ni: snying kar bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i gzhal med khang sgo gcig pa'i nang du ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje mi bskyod pa tshon gang ba gsal ba'i sgo srung rta mgrin yab yum tu gsal la ye shes sems dpa' 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs bar bsam la/ hūm̐: thabs kyi spyod pas gzhan don du: byams dang snying rje'i gang 'dul ba: sangs rgyas phrin las rjogs mjad pa'i: dbang dang byin rlabs bdag stsol cig: rigs lnga'i dbang rgya gnas so sor bzhag la: oṃ ma hā shu bya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bha wa at+ma ko3 hi: de bzhin du shu bya ta'i mal du: a dar+sha: sa ma ta: pra t+ya bek+ṣa: kri t+ya a nuṣ+ṭha: bcug: de nas kham gsum kyi srog la dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: 'gro drug nyon mongs bcing ba rnams: hūm̐ gis dug chen (198)rab sbyangs te: a nri su tri sre du gyur: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ las me rlung chus: 'gro ba rab sbyangs hūm̐ du gyur: khams gsum thams cad rdo rje sems: til gyi gong bu lta bu'i gang : rta mgrin rgyal po ye shes la: bstim pas byang chub sems rgyas gyur: yab yum gnyis med sbyor ba'i sgras: ye shes khro bo spyan drangs ngo : de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: srid pa phur bur bsgrub pa dang : dbang dang dngos grub stsol ba'i phyir: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol: khro bo chen po gshegs nas kyang : rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang : rdo rje phur bu'i dngos grub stsol: thugs rje'i lcags kyus rgyud bskul zhing : byams pa'i zhags pas spyan 'dren no:

lcags sgrogs bka' yi pho nyas btab: bde gshegs dril bus dgyes pa bskyed: oṃ h+ya hi ma hā kā ru ṇi ka tri sh+ya ho: bzhugs gsol ni: hūm̐: thugs mchog gsal ba'i byin rlabs las: zhe sdang gnas su 'joms pa dang : me long ye shes thob bya'i phyir: (199)dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhugs su gsol: dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhugs nas kyang : nyon mongs mun pa bsal du gsol: sa ma yā tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ni: hūm̐: yang dag don du sku ni cir snang yang : bdud dang srin po'i nga rgyal ma yin te: 'dul ba'i dbang gis rab rngams mche ba gcig: hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgras ni kun kyang bkang : nyon mongs gdug pa 'dul ba'i thugs rjes yis: byin rlabs ster ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pu ho: pra ti ts+tsha ho: mchod pa ni: spro na phyag rgya gar mchado ni: hūm̐: sgeg dpa' 'jigs rung sku yi gar: dgod gshe drag shul gsung gi gar: snying rje rngam zhi thugs kyi gar: rang byung gar dgu'i mchod pa 'bul: ma hā mu tra su tsa ho: ye shes glu yi mchod pa ni: hūm̐: dga' ba bcu drug rdo rje'i klu: ye shes glu dang mnyam sbyor ba: rang las dbyung zhing rang la mchod: mi rtog ye shes mngon du ston: ma hā dz+nyā na te te (200)hūm̐: te na te te hūm̐: nyer spyod 'dod yon gyi mchod pa ni: hūm̐: nyer spyod lnga dang 'dod g.yon kun: dbang po lnga yi rgyan du shar: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po yis: dpal chen lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: oṃ bikra badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra dhu pe hūm̐: pūṣ+pe tram̐: a lo ke hri: ghan+de ho: nai wi d+ya ā: shab+ta hūm̐ḥsarba pū tsa sa ma yā ho: gsang ba dug gsum gnas su dag pa'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: 'dod chags khrag chen zhe sdang rus: gti mug sha ste dug gsum yang : gdod na sku gsum chen po'i ngang : rang las shar zhing rang sar grol: ha la pañca pū ja ho: sman mchod ni: rdo rje'i dam tshig rmad po che:

rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i bdud: rgyud drug sdug bsngal 'joms pa'i rtsi: rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañca amṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: dbyings rig yab yum snang stong he ru ka: chos kyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang : rig 'jin 'dus pa bla ma'i dkyil 'khor la: myong grol bdud rtsi sman (201)gyi mchod pa 'bul: sarba pañca amṛṃ ta khā raṃ khā hi: 'jam dpal rdo rje khri sdong lde'u btsan: grub chen brgyad dang las can dag pa'i 'khor: brgyud pa bdun ldan thugs gter bdag po la: myong grol bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul/ sarba pañca amṛṃ ta khā raṃ khā hi: ye shes dgu rdzogs khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor la: dpal gyi bka' sdod 'jig rten dregs pa'i sde: phur pa phrin las bsam yas lhun grub la: myong grol bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul: sarba pañca amṛṃ ta khā raṃ khā hi: dngos grub blang ba ni: bdud rtsi snying po can gyi dbus: sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs: yi ge gsum gyi rnam pa can: dam tshig phyag rgya gnyan pos blang : ka ya sid+dhi oṃ: wak+ka sid+dhi a: tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: mtho ba srin nyi zla'i ga 'us blang : dam rdzas gtor ma'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: bha ga yangs pa'i gtong gzhong du: liṅga 'dod yon gtor ma 'bar: rdo rje bza' ba'i dam tshig rdzas: a la la ste dgyes (202)par rol: ma hā ba ling+ta khā hi: rak+ta'i mchod pa ni: lcang lor bcas pa'i dung chen du: chags sdang dbyings su bsgral ba'i khrag: 'khor ba gnas su dag bya'i phyir: blang dor med par bzhes su gsol: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: bdud rtsi gsang nan ni: hūm̐: yab dang yum gyi rgyu gnyis kyang : phyag rgya bzhi yi rkyen gyis sbyar: dug lnga sman du gyur pa'i rdzas: ja gad dpa' bo'i bdud rtsis mchod: ma hā badz+ra amṛṃ ta ja gad pū ja ho: sbyor sgrol gyi mchado pa ni: hūm̐:ཿ rdo rje phung po'i pad+mo'i grong khyer la:

snyoms par zhugs pas rab bskul bas: lha tshogs kun kyang mnyam gyur te: sdug bsngal bde ba chen por sbyor: rnam rtog bdag med dbyings su sgrol: jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ta na ga na pū ja ho: bsdu na de'i tshab tu: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol: oṃ shrī badz+ra ku ma ra sa pa ri wa ra (203)ar+ghaṃ nas shab+ta bar dang sarba pañca rak+ta ba ling+ta khā hi: rgyas bsdus ji ltar yang phur pa'i dgos chos rak+ta tshar gsum ni: phud dang rak+ta bsre: dang po pho nya la bka' bsgos te mngon spyod kyi tshul du phul nas: hūm̐: dngos grub bar gcod byed pa'i bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: zungs cig rgyob cig rnam par chings: rtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis: rengs par khug smrar chug cig: phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis: nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang : bsgo ba'i bka' ni nyan par gyis: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: gnyis pa dam can la tha tshig bsgrag pa'i phyir phul nas: hūm̐: bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs: khyed kyi dam tshig dus la bab: sngon chad ji ltar dam bcas pa'i: mngon spyod phrin las myur du mjod: ma hā rak+ta khā hī: gsum pa gnod byed kyi mthu dang rdzu 'phrul phrog phyir phrul nas: hūm̐: dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: lha'am 'on te bdud kyang rung : nga la bar chad byed (204)pa rnams: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par mjod: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang : dgod dang gshed dang 'jigs pa ston pa dang : snying rje rngam zhi rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: zhe sdang 'joms pa'i lha la la phyag 'tshal bstod: yab kyi thugs dam dgyes pa skong ba'i yum: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'dod chags 'joms ma dang :

e ka tsa ti zhe sdang 'joms mjad ma: 'dod chags tshul gyis 'dod chags 'joms la bstod: ye shes lnga ldan phur bas dug lnga 'joms: phrin las lnga yis dregs pa sgrol ba la: thogs pa med pa'i las mjad 'dus pa lngaḥ sras mchog rigs lnga'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ye shes rol pa'i stobs bcus mi dge 'joms: sku gsung thugs kyis gdug pa sgrol bar mjad: yang dag don gyis log 'dren 'joms mjad pa: khro bo yab yum bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod: byang chub bde la rol pa'i pho nya mo: gdul bya'i (205)don la khra thabs gzugs 'jin cing : dregs pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus 'dul mjad pa: phra men pho nya'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ jas dgongs ni: bsgrub pa dang sgrub chen sogs la: bh+rūm̐ bi shwa shud+dhe phaṭa:ja: sa jab khang dbye nas bdag mdun gyi rnam par gsal ba kun la 'gro zhing bsnyen pa ni: hūm̐: thugs kar dpal gyi be'u dkyil 'khor nasaḥ sgo gcig rin chen gzhal yas khang : bde stong dbyer med ngang nyid las: chos kyi sku las longs skur shar: pad+ma zla'i gdan la bzhugs: skyon gyis ma gos gti mug sel: yab yum gnyis med zag med sku: sku mdog dkar gsal rnam dag dbyings: rdo rje dril bu phyag na bsnams: shes rab byang chub sems dang ldan: rtog med mi 'gyur dkyil krung bzhugs: mkha' dbyings bde chen sku la bstod: oṃ ni dpal chen yab yin te: badz+ra shes rab yum yin no: kī ni ye shes khro bo la: li ni dbyings kyi khro bo yum: kī ni thabs kyi mche ba can: (206)la ni shes rab gshogs pa can: ya ni sras mchog phur pa ste: hūm̐ ni phyag brnyan sgo ma bzhi: sarba thams cad 'dus pa ste: big ni dgra dang bgegs yin te: nan ni dgra dag bgegs mnan no: baṃ ni dbang du sdud pa ste: hūm̐ḥni brlag par byed pa'o: phaṭa kyis sgrol ba'i phrin las mjod: ces so sa ya tha ma bye ba 'bring : smin par 'dod la grangs nges med:

'di la yi dam byed pa rnams: bar chad bdud kyis mi tshugs shing : phrin las kun la mda' brnyes 'gyur: rjes la tshogs kyis mchod pa sogs: las gzhung bzhin tu bya ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen thugs la ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: 'phros pas tshogs kyi dngos 'jin sbyangs: snang srid bde chen ka pā la: bcud rnams rigs lnga'i dam rdzas gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī: spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang dang : yan lag bdun ldan longs spyod rdzogs: rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing khams nas: dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang : gnas dang nye gnas rnam pa gnyis: yul ni rol pa nye yul rol: (207)zhing dang nye ba'i zhing dang ni: 'du dang nye ba'i 'du ba dang : tshan+dho nye ba'i tshan+dho ste: he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang : dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal: o ṭi ya nar pad+ma brtsegs: za hor yul na khu byug klo: sing nga'i yul na sku la rjogs: kha che'i yul na he chen rol: bal bo'i yul na ya ma khad: thod gar yul na gsang chen rol: li yul 'jig rten mngon rdzogs te: dur khrod chen po brgyad rnams na: bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma: shugs 'gro rnal 'byor zhing skyongs rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: tshogs khang 'di ni sprul pa'i zhing : tshogs rdzas 'dod yon rol pa'i rgyan: thabs dang shes rab lcam dral ldan: rdo rje glu gar byin re chags: cang te'u dril bu snyan cing 'khrol: 'di ni dam tshig mchog gi gnas: shags dang rtsod pa ku co med: rig pa brtul zhugs nyams dang ldan: dam tshig (208)'di ni dang du bzhes: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rtsol: gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki ni dharma pa la sa ma ya jaḥ phud dang po ni: hūm̐: sangs rgyas dam tshig bla na med: sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lngaḥ bza' bca' btung ba phyi yi tshogs: 'dod yon lha mo rnam pa lnga: dbang po'i longs spyod nang gi tshogs: bde stong ye shes bla na med:

dga' bzhi'i rnam ral gsang ba'i tshogs: dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ga ṇa tsakra pū tsa ho: bar pa bshags pa ni: hūm̐: gang zhig 'khrul pa gyur pa de nas bzung : rnam smin lus la brten pa de srid du: mi dge bcu dang mtshams med nye ba lnga: lci ba bcu drug log pa brgyad la sogs: theg pa gsum dang rig pa 'jin pa yi: sdom gsum dam tshig nyams pa mtha' dag kun: ga ṇa tshogs kyi 'khor lo la brten nas: 'chab pa med pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags: dag tshangs chen po'i dngos grub bdag la (209)stsol: he ru ka'i yig brgya brjod: tha ma bsgral mchod ni: e las thar med srid pa'i brug khung nang : ma rig 'khrul bas bcing ba'i bdag lta'i dgra: ye shes dbyings la sgrib pa'i gzung 'jin bgegs: dag chen ye shes rig pa'i lcags kyus zungs: mnyam par ma bzhag med pa'i zhags pas chings: lhag mthong lu gu rgyud kyi drwa bas sdom: rjes thob 'khrul ba med pa'i dril bus myos: phung po lnga yi nye bar len pa kun: bdag med rtogs pa'i mtshon gyis rnam par gtub: skye med khros pa'i lha tshogs zhal du bstab: mam̐ pa rak+ta tsit+ta ko ro tsa naḥ ba su ta kengaṃ ni rta ta na tsakra pū tsa khā hi khā hi: rgyas par spro na skabs 'dir skong bshags rdo rje'i thol glus thugs dam bskang ngo : de nas lhag ma ni: zhing lpags kyi steng du bzhag la: he ru ka'i dam rgyas la phru btab: kyeḥ dang po phud kyi mi mchod du: dpal chen dkyil 'khor tshogs kyi bdag: bar du bshags pa mi bgyi ru: rnal 'byor (210)ldan la dam tshig gnyan: tha ma bsgral bstab mi bgyi ru: rtogs pas bdag rgyud sngon bsgral phyir: da lta lhag ma mi mchod du: ma tshogs dbang phyug ging liṅka: pho nya sum brgya drug cu sogs: kun kyang dpal chen sprul pa yin: lhag ma kha chus mi bran du: dam tshig gcig tu bsre ba'i phyir:

'bangs thog rje yis mi mnan du: ci bcol sa la bskul ba'i phyir: rje la 'bangs kyis mi rgol du: drag shul las thabs myur ba'i phyir: hūm̐: rnam dag rang bzhin zhi ba las: bcom ldan dpal chen sprul pa ni: thabs shes zla gsang rol pa las: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba ste: khyed cag sngon gyi yal gam can: lag na glo snying nang khrol thogs: legs nyais stangs 'jin tshogs khang nyul: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med: sngon tshe dpal chen he ru kas: dug gsum rū tra bsgral ba'i tshe: khas blang dam bcas dran gyis la: srin mo'i za lam chen mo ru: pham phab longs la bstan pa srung : (211)bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mjod: thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: mi gnas ye shes chos sku'i pho brang nas: longs spyod rjogs pa zhi dang khro bo'i lha: thugs dam bskul lo 'gro ba'i don la dgongs: rig pa'i rang bzhin bde gshegs snying po yang : ma rig 'jin pa'i kun gzhi lung ma bstan: sgo lnga'i yul dang rten cing 'brel ba las: rigs drug rgyud lnga'i gnas su 'khyams pa rnams: las dang nyon mongs mthu yis gzir ba'i mthu: phyi rol yul la smin pa'i sdug bsngal dang : nad mtshon mu ge dgra bgegs 'byung po'i gdon: 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug kun: mngon spyod drag po'i rol pas tshar bcad nas: log rtog dngos por zhen pa'i sems can rnams: rgyu 'bras theg pa gzhan gyis gdul dka' bas: rang byung ye shes rtogs pa'i phrin las mjod:

chad tho bsgrags pa ni: hūm̐: dus gsum rnam dag kun tu bzang po'i dus: mngon rjogs ye shes dam pa'i 'og min du: kun gzhi yid chos dag (212)pa'i ston pa yis: rang snang rang bzhin med pa'i 'khor tshogs la: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rjogs pa'i yo ga gsum: brda tshig brjod pa bral bar bstan pa'i tshe: grags chen gsal ba'i ston pa bcu gnyis dang : dga' rab dpa' bo gsang 'jin rdo rje chos: brda brgyud rig 'jin grub pa mchog rnams kyis: ston 'khor dgongs pa gcig pa'i dbang thob bzhin: tshogs brgyad rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la: 'khrul pa gzhi la dag pa'i phrin las mjod: de rjes gsang sngags bstan pa byung ba'i tshe: 'og min dga' ldan ri rab lhun po'i rtser: lha gnas gsum du grags pa'i gnas mchog dang : sham bha la dang o rgyan za hor yul: seng ga la dang gnas lcags 'bar ba'i rtse: mchod rten chen po bde byed brtsegs pa ru: rig 'jin sde snod mtha' dag bab pa'i tshe: 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro dang : dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba thams cad kyis: gtor ma len cing legs nyes stangs 'jin pa'i: khas blang dam bca' (213)bzhin du phrin las mjod: de rjes 'gro don dus la bab pa'i tshe: klu grub snying po pad+ma thod phreng sogs: grub pa'i rig 'jin chen po brgyad rnams kyis: 'jam bu'i gling du dar rgyas mjad cing : khyad par brag dmar dpal gyi mtshims phu ru: rig 'jin slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: lha sras rgyal po tshangs pa'i me tog la: bsgrub pa bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor zhal phyes zhing : seng ge rnam rol khas bu ri yi rtser: gnod sbyin thams cad dam ma bzhag pa'i tshe: srog snying phul te chad tho bzung ba ltar: mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las grub par mjod: de rjes tshogs bdun rol pa bal po'i yul: rang snang mchod rten bya rung kha shor du: rang byung rdo rje 'jigs med gling pa la:

dbyings kyi mkha' 'gros nam mkha' mjod kyi brda: ye shes lnga ldan sprul pa'i shog ser las: brag dmar bre gu brtsegs pa'i ge'u ru: kun tu bzang po dri med 'od zer gyis: bka' rgya lung rjogs gtad rgya bkrol ba'i tshe: spyan gcig khrag tu khol ba'i (214)ma mo dang : bya rog gtsug phud 'jin pa'i drang srong gis: khas blangs tha tshig bzhin tu phrin las mjod: bshal chu gtor ma bran la: brtan ma bskyang ba ni: bh+yo: tshogs dang bka' yi bdag nyid ni: khrag 'thung rdo rje nam mkha'i yum: gangs ri can gyi yul lha ni: bdud dang gnod sbyin sman mo bzhi: tshur spyon tshur spyon gtor ma longs: rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis dang : dus sbyor bcu gnyis gnas dag pas: bal bod mtshams na tshe ring ma: la stod rdo rje g.ya' ma skyongs: gnod sbyin gangs la kun bzang mo: 'brog chen 'khor 'dul bgegs kyi gtso: jo mo gangs rir spyan gcig ma: byang nam mkha' lding klu mo rgyal: kha rag rdo rje khyung btsun ma: rma chen spoṃ rar drag mo rgyal: kong btsun de mo bod khams skyong : 'brog btsan rdo rje smam gcig ma: jo mo nams rgyal g.yar mo bsil: dbus na rdo rje zu le sman: kun kyang pad+ma'i bka' nyan te: dam la gnas shing rigs la 'god: tha tshig bzhin (215)du gtor ma longs: mtha' yi dmags dang rgya 'dre'i 'tshubs: mu stegs 'gyu ba'i sgo 'phrang du: 'gong po spun dgu'i nad la bsrung : rtag chad thar bar 'khrul pa yi: 'jig tshogs lta ba dbu mar bzlog: bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis kyi: bstan pa dar ba'i phrin las mjod: oṃ la la le lo taṃ taṃ te te kha rag+ma ma ma sring 'gro ma hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐ hūm̐: gtor gzhong ri rab tu bsal la kha sbub la: hūm̐: dam sri bya ba'i sdig can khyod: 'gro ba yongs kyi rgyud la rgol: byang chub sems kyi brtul zhugs bros: mnan no stong chen 'og tu mnan: gtad do chu srin gre bar gtad:

bskyur ro gshin rje'i kha ru bskyur: bsreg go ye shes me yis bsregs: bdag tu lta ba ma zhig par: bskal ba zhig kyang mi btang ngo : oṃ āḥhūm̐ stam+bha ya lam nan: de nas dngos grub blang ba ni: sngar bzhin mchod cing bstod la: hūm̐:ཿ byin rlabs kun gyi rtsa ba bla ma ni: dngos grub (216)rtsol phyir dpal chen rol pa'i lha: rnam thar sgo gsum thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: rang bzhin yongs grub byang chub sems kyi dngos: phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub stsol: sa bcu lam lnga dbang bcu phyi nang gnyi: rig 'jin bzhi dang sku lnga ye shes lnga: grub chen brgyad dang phrin las rnam pa bzhi: 'khor ba'i rang bzhin glo bur sgrib pa gnyis: kun gzhi'i khams la bag la nyal ba'i tshul: shin tu rnam dag rnam kun mchog ldan gyi: dngos grub dam pa deng 'dir rtsal du gsol: rtsa sngags mthar: dharmā kā ya: sam+bho kā ya: nirma kā ya: tsirta sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes sgrub rdzas gnas gsum du gtug cing myong ngo : slar yang gtang rag gi mchod bstod phul la: bshags pa bya ba ni: ho: sngags kyi dngos grub ma lus pa: dam tshig nyid la brten gyur kyang : rmongs dang ma rig nyon mongs pas: zil gyis non pa bdag cag ni: nyes pa du ma'i snod lags te: mgon po thugs rje che rnams kyi: (217)thugs la khro ba mi mnga' yang : legs nyes stangs 'jin bdag po rnams: skyon mthong tsam na chad pa gcod: 'gal zhing nongs pa ci mchis pa: mthol lo bshags so tshangs par stsol: yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis snying nas bshags par bya'o: nyer bsdu ni: hūm̐: snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas su: shar ba dag pa'i snod bcud kyang : rten nyid brten pa lha rnams kyang : gtso bo la thim de yang hūm̐: zhabs kyu nas bzung na dā'i bar: rim yal gdod ma'i gshis su ā: zhes mnyam par bzhag: spyod lam gyi rnal 'gyor du ldang ba ni: slar yang rig pa byang chub sems:

rjes thob gnyug ma'i he ru ka: phyag rgya gcig pa'i gnas gsum du: yi ges mtshan pas rnam rtog bsrung : badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ: zhes rdo rje'i go bgo zhing : yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya'o: de nas bsngo smon ni: hūm̐: snang grags rig pa dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngang : bsod nams ye shes rim gnyis rnal 'byor tshogs: mi gnas ye shes mya ngan 'das par bsngo: kun kyang dpal chen go (218)'phang thob par shog: lan gsum: bkra shis ni: hūm̐: gdod ma'i mgon po rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho: sku lnga lhun rdzogs sprul pa'i zhing khams la: bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa byon pa yi: sgron me'i bskal pa bzang po'i bkra shis shog: stong gsum mi 'jed rdo rje'i theg pa'i zhing : 'phur 'gro'i bstan pa 'byung gnas o rgyan yul: gangs ri'i khrod du 'bod pa khri srong rje'i: thugs bskyed bstan pa mtha' rgyas bkra shis shog: 'jam gling pa yi lte ba rdo rje'i gdan: paṇa grub chos rgyal 'jom pa chos 'khor gsum: mdo sngags bstan pa dar ba gangs can ljongs: rgyal bstan yul du gnas pa'i bkra shis shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rgyud sde rgya mtsho don gyi dbyings: dgongs brda snyan brgyud shog ser las: gcus dkrugs gab pa'i mnad gsal ba: pad+ma'i ring lugs dam pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rga: :
